changelog: Unidirectional nodes: the child never polls the parent - the parent pushes its stats on every heartbeat, so the Managed-by card shows live online status and metrics, and its detail pane renders instantly from the local record. Cluster card: fixed physical CPU core total (from /sys possible) that no longer oscillates, plus sticky cluster snapshot on transient fetch errors. Container logs are per-instance: recreating a container with the same name starts a fresh log (the previous log is kept until then). Stacks and Backups pages re-enabled with their modals.
